title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
description: Rival real estate agents both make the same wish during the first snow of the winter: to win the most coveted listing in town. As the business competitors begrudgingly work together, they learn the house comes with a special commission: love.

title: Love at the Christmas Contest
description: Angie enters a tree decorating contest to honor the memory of her mother. To Angie's surprise, her high school sweetheart, David, and his daughter, Gabby, have entered the contest as well.

title: Destined 2: Christmas Once More
description: Theo continues to miss connecting with his girlfriend, Kim, as he attempts to propose at Christmas.

title: Royally Wrapped for Christmas
description: Lindsay, the NY director of an international charity organization, is called to the Kingdom of Veronia by the royal family to interview for the job of overseeing the whole operation. During the interview process, she finds true love with the prince.

title: A Royal Icing Christmas
description: A secret baking contest and an unexpected romance teach a duty-bound princess that love may be life's true crowning achievement.

title: Christmas on Every Page
description: A woman returns home for the holidays to help her mother's struggling bookstore. As she reconnects with her roots, she starts to question whether success is measured by career milestones -- or by love, creativity, and the joy of truly belonging.

title: Christmas at Mistletoe Manor
description: When a cooking show influencer travels to a centuries-old English castle to honor a World War II nurse, she finds herself swept up by the castle's holiday magic and the unexpected warmth of its charming proprietor.

title: Call Me Mrs. Miracle
description: Mrs. "Miracle" Merkle (Doris Roberts) helps save a struggling department store during the Christmas season.

title: Love Always, Santa
description: A widow's daughter writes to Santa Claus, asking for her mother to find love again. When a struggling writer receives the letter, he finds new inspiration and the beginnings of a romance.

title: Journey to Christmas
description: A winter storm forces a New York City fashion model to spend the week before Christmas with her chauffeur and his extended family in rural America.

title: A Belgian Chocolate Christmas
description: A photographer takes her best friend's place at a Belgian culinary school during the holidays and connects with the chocolatier leading the class. A case of mistaken identity impacts their blossoming romance.

title: A Royal Christmas Tail
description: A prince swaps a glass slipper for a dog tag in his Christmas search for the woman and her dog who stole his heart during one enchanted holiday encounter.

title: Christmas by Candlelight
description: Juliet pitches selling Christmas memory candles to her boss, and asks candle store owner Tom to create new scents. He refuses at first but agrees after realizing the money will help make his daughter's Christmas wish come true.

title: A Wisconsin Christmas Pie
description: A pastry chef returns to Wisconsin when she learns her family's farm is on the brink of being sold to developers. Reconnecting with her high school sweetheart, they discover love may just be the recipe for saving the farm -- and their hearts.

title: A Cinderella Christmas
description: At a holiday masquerade ball, Angie and Nicholas meet and fall for each other anonymously. While Nicholas tries to locate the girl of his dreams, Angie must choose between pursuing her lifelong dream of running a business or following her heart.

title: A Very Curious Christmas
description: A rising star reporter must uncover the identity of a local late-night bandit who has been stealing beautiful home Christmas displays across the city.

title: Aisle Be Home for Christmas
description: Due to a sudden blizzard, a group of Christmas shoppers and employees, Drew and Michelle included, are stranded in their local big box store. Drew and Michelle realize just how much joy they've been missing out on by not being in each other's lives.

title: A Christmas for the Ages
description: Prompted by their youngest granddaughter, four generations of women celebrate Christmas and family in the style of the 40s, 60s, 90s, and today.

title: A Royal Christmas Holiday
description: An ambitious reporter tracks down a prince who is in town for the dedication of a naval museum honoring his late grandfather. She convinces him to show his followers that his work is more than just a job, and the two begin to fall for each other.

title: The Art of Christmas
description: After her latest gallery exhibition literally goes up in flames, struggling artist Liv James accepts a teaching job at a local elementary school to make ends meet.

title: A Christmas Wish in Hudson
description: A woman takes a shot at love after seeing a widowed firefighter and chef on a cooking show. With the help of his daughter, the two of them might find love this Christmas.

title: Tails of Christmas
description: Caleb gets injured in the army and begins recovering through help from shelter therapy dogs. As a sign of thanks, Caleb returns home to help Amber run the local shelter and in the process, discovers his feelings for Amber go beyond gratitude.

title: Designing Christmas With You
description: With her career on the line, a decorator must work with an unexpected partner to showcase a house for an upcoming Christmas gala.

title: Destined at Christmas
description: After Kim and Theo meet in the midst of Black Friday shopping madness, they are determined to meet again.

title: Pencil Me in for Christmas
description: An aspiring illustrator teams up with a demanding author to work on a children's book. As they create their Christmas-themed project in a nostalgic small town, they find themselves rediscovering the holiday spirit.

title: A Royal Date for Christmas
description: When a European Duke arrives in the US, he realizes that his bags have been lost in transit; he has no choice but to be styled, and ultimately inspired, by Bella, the owner of a local boutique.

title: Christmas North of Nashville
description: A woman rediscovers love, community, and the holiday spirit after returning home to save her family's Christmas carnival.

title: 12 Games of Christmas
description: Two old friends and a group of their neighbors are transported into a Christmas-themed board game during a Christmas party.

title: Christmas Sweethearts
description: When a woman returns home to find her ex in a relationship, she enlists her best friend to act as her fake boyfriend.

title: A Christmas Star
description: An astronomer predicts that a new meteor shower will appear over a tiny town, but she must convince the locals to help with her discovery at the expense of a Christmas tradition.

title: Coupled Up for Christmas
description: Tiffany finally reunites with her longtime crush, Brett, only to find out he has a serious girlfriend. She decides to pair up with a recently heartbroken Peter to win back the affection of their respective soulmates.

title: My Favorite Christmas Tree
description: Kyla visits a small town attempting to find her ancestry and meets a Christmas tree farm owner.

title: Our Christmas Wedding
description: Roles reverse as Nicole's boss plans newly engaged Nicole and Michael's wedding in two weeks at Christmas.

title: A Royal Christmas Holiday
description: An ambitious reporter tracks down a prince who is in town for the dedication of a naval museum honoring his late grandfather. She convinces him to show his followers that his work is more than just a job, and the two begin to fall for each other.

title: A Dogwalker's Christmas Tale
description: A spoiled college student walks a developer's dog and is delighted when she sees he plans to build a salon over a nearby dog park. When she meets a handsome dog walker at the park, she tries to put aside her selfish ways to help him save the park.

title: The Art of Christmas
description: After her latest gallery exhibition literally goes up in flames, struggling artist Liv James accepts a teaching job at a local elementary school to make ends meet.

title: The Spruces and the Pines
description: The Spruces and the Pines, rival tree farm-owning families, have been feuding for years. When the respective heirs fall in love, they must keep their growing romance a secret, or they'll risk a Christmas blow-up that could destroy everything.

title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
description: A city manager recruits the help of a childhood friend to save his town's Christmas charity event, while she attempts to set him up with her close friend.

title: Snowmance
description: A true romantic finally gets her chance at the love she's always dreamed of when a little Christmas magic brings her snowman to life.

title: A Vintage Christmas
description: A dedicated preservationist battles a developer's ambitions to tear down a historic Post Office with ties to her family. The choice of old versus new threatens to divide the small town unless there is a solution for the greater good of all concerned.

title: Call Me Mrs. Miracle
description: Mrs. "Miracle" Merkle (Doris Roberts) helps save a struggling department store during the Christmas season.

title: A Royal Christmas on Ice
description: Looking to escape his royal life, a dashing prince comes to the United States to start a business in a small town in upstate New York and winds up falling for a former Olympic ice skater.

title: Santa, Maybe
description: Theater director Lila must rise to the challenge of putting on the perfect Christmas ballet alongside a difficult new colleague, while also discovering her office secret Santa in the process.
